```{r setup, include=FALSE}
set.seed(42)

root_dir <- "benchmark_results/q20_ee22_both_full_cutadapt_forward"
results_dir <- file.path("Results", "01f_complete_forward_Cutadapt_vs_ITSxpress")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("Phyloseq", showWarnings = FALSE)

method_colors <- c("Cutadapt" = "#0072B2", "ITSxpress" = "#D55E00")
group_colors <- c("Control" = "#D55E00", "True" = "#0072B2", "Mock" = "#009E73")
subject_shapes <- c("Control" = 15, "KSY" = 16, "PYH" = 17, "Mock" = 18)

soyeon_theme <- theme_classic(base_family = "Noto Sans CJK KR", base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey55"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"

datatable_basic <- function(x, page_length = 10) {
  DT::datatable(
    x, rownames = FALSE, filter = "none",
    options = list(dom = "tp", pageLength = page_length, autoWidth = TRUE)
  )
}

get_otu <- function(ps) {
  x <- as(phyloseq::otu_table(ps), "matrix")
  if (!phyloseq::taxa_are_rows(ps)) x <- t(x)
  x
}

metadata_source_ps <- readRDS(
  "Phyloseq/phy_ITS2_cutadapt_single_complete_q20_ee2_20261016.rds"
)
q2_metadata <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(metadata_source_ps), check.names = FALSE) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Sample_Type = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(Subject, stringr::regex("mock|zymo", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Mock",
      stringr::str_detect(Subject, stringr::regex("^(ASwab|CSwab|ETube)", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Control",
      TRUE ~ "True"
    ),
    Control_Type = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(Subject, stringr::regex("^ASwab", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Air swab",
      stringr::str_detect(Subject, stringr::regex("^CSwab", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Clean bench swab",
      stringr::str_detect(Subject, stringr::regex("^ETube", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Empty tube",
      Sample_Type == "Mock" ~ "Mock",
      TRUE ~ "Skin sample"
    ),
    Subject_Display = dplyr::case_when(
      Sample_Type == "Control" ~ "Control",
      Sample_Type == "Mock" ~ "Mock",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Subject)
    ),
    Site_Display = dplyr::case_when(
      Sample_Type == "True" ~ as.character(Region),
      TRUE ~ as.character(Control_Type)
    ),
    Sample_Type = factor(as.character(Sample_Type), levels = c("Control", "True", "Mock")),
    PCR_Cycle_Group = factor(
      PCR_Cycle_Group,
      levels = c(
        "PCR1_33__PCR2_8", "PCR1_33__PCR2_10",
        "PCR1_35__PCR2_8", "PCR1_35__PCR2_10"
      )
    )
  )

tax_clean <- function(ps) {
  tax <- data.frame(phyloseq::tax_table(ps), check.names = FALSE)
  tax[] <- lapply(tax, function(x) {
    x <- stringr::str_replace(as.character(x), "^[dkpcofgs]__", "")
    x[is.na(x) | x %in% c("", "__", "NA", "uncultured", "Unassigned")] <- ""
    x
  })
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(tax))) {
    if (tax$Species[i] != "") {
      tax$Species[i] <- stringr::str_replace_all(tax$Species[i], " ", "_")
    } else if (tax$Phylum[i] == "") {
      tax[i, 2:7] <- paste0(tax$Kingdom[i], "_k")
    } else if (tax$Class[i] == "") {
      tax[i, 3:7] <- paste0(tax$Phylum[i], "_p")
    } else if (tax$Order[i] == "") {
      tax[i, 4:7] <- paste0(tax$Class[i], "_c")
    } else if (tax$Family[i] == "") {
      tax[i, 5:7] <- paste0(tax$Order[i], "_o")
    } else if (tax$Genus[i] == "") {
      tax[i, 6:7] <- paste0(tax$Family[i], "_f")
    } else {
      tax$Species[i] <- paste0(tax$Genus[i], "_g")
    }
  }
  phyloseq::tax_table(ps) <- phyloseq::tax_table(as.matrix(tax))
  ps
}

make_phyloseq <- function(method) {
  table_path <- file.path(root_dir, "dada2", tolower(method), "single", "table.qza")
  taxonomy_path <- file.path(
    root_dir, "taxonomy", tolower(method), "single",
    "unite_v10_99_full", "taxonomy.tsv"
  )
  count_matrix <- qiime2R::read_qza(table_path)[["data"]]
  taxonomy_input <- readr::read_tsv(taxonomy_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  taxonomy_split <- stringr::str_split_fixed(taxonomy_input$Taxon, ";", 8)
  taxonomy_matrix <- taxonomy_split[, 1:7, drop = FALSE]
  colnames(taxonomy_matrix) <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
  rownames(taxonomy_matrix) <- taxonomy_input$`Feature ID`
  missing_taxonomy <- setdiff(rownames(count_matrix), rownames(taxonomy_matrix))
  if (length(missing_taxonomy) > 0) {
    missing_matrix <- matrix("", nrow = length(missing_taxonomy), ncol = 7,
                             dimnames = list(missing_taxonomy, colnames(taxonomy_matrix)))
    taxonomy_matrix <- rbind(taxonomy_matrix, missing_matrix)
  }
  metadata_frame <- q2_metadata |>
    dplyr::filter(SampleID %in% colnames(count_matrix)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(match(SampleID, colnames(count_matrix))) |>
    tibble::column_to_rownames("SampleID") |>
    data.frame(check.names = FALSE)
  count_matrix <- count_matrix[, rownames(metadata_frame), drop = FALSE]
  taxonomy_matrix <- taxonomy_matrix[rownames(count_matrix), , drop = FALSE]
  phy_raw <- phyloseq::phyloseq(
    phyloseq::otu_table(count_matrix, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
    phyloseq::tax_table(taxonomy_matrix),
    phyloseq::sample_data(metadata_frame)
  )
  phy_taxclean <- tax_clean(phy_raw)
  kingdom <- as.character(phyloseq::tax_table(phy_taxclean)[, "Kingdom"])
  phy_fungi <- phyloseq::prune_taxa(kingdom == "Fungi", phy_taxclean)
  phy_final <- phyloseq::prune_samples(phyloseq::sample_sums(phy_fungi) > 0, phy_fungi)
  phy_final <- phyloseq::prune_taxa(phyloseq::taxa_sums(phy_final) > 0, phy_final)
  audit <- tibble::tibble(
    Method = method,
    Stage = c("Imported ASV table", "Taxonomy cleaned", "Kingdom == Fungi retained", "Zero-sum removed"),
    Samples = c(nsamples(phy_raw), nsamples(phy_taxclean), nsamples(phy_fungi), nsamples(phy_final)),
    ASVs = c(ntaxa(phy_raw), ntaxa(phy_taxclean), ntaxa(phy_fungi), ntaxa(phy_final)),
    Reads = c(sum(sample_sums(phy_raw)), sum(sample_sums(phy_taxclean)),
              sum(sample_sums(phy_fungi)), sum(sample_sums(phy_final)))
  )
  list(raw = phy_raw, cleaned = phy_final, audit = audit)
}

cutadapt_result <- make_phyloseq("Cutadapt")
itsxpress_result <- make_phyloseq("ITSxpress")
phy_cutadapt <- cutadapt_result$cleaned
phy_itsxpress <- itsxpress_result$cleaned

saveRDS(phy_cutadapt, "Phyloseq/phy_ITS2_cutadapt_single_complete_q20_ee2_20261016.rds")
saveRDS(phy_itsxpress, "Phyloseq/phy_ITS2_itsxpress_single_complete_q20_ee2_20261016.rds")

get_species_count <- function(ps) {
  otu <- get_otu(ps)
  tax <- data.frame(phyloseq::tax_table(ps), check.names = FALSE)
  label <- dplyr::case_when(
    tax$Species != "" ~ stringr::str_replace_all(tax$Species, "_", " "),
    tax$Genus != "" ~ paste0(tax$Genus, " sp."),
    tax$Family != "" ~ paste0(tax$Family, " (unclassified)"),
    TRUE ~ "Unclassified fungi"
  )
  rowsum(otu, group = label, reorder = FALSE)
}

cut_species <- get_species_count(phy_cutadapt)
its_species <- get_species_count(phy_itsxpress)
```

# 분석 범위

- 동일한 83개 library의 **완전한 forward read**를 사용함.
- Cutadapt single-end와 ITSxpress single-end를 비교함.
- QC20, DADA2 maxEE 2 조건은 동일하며 ITS 경계 처리만 다름.
- rarefaction으로 library를 제거하지 않았으며, Aitchison 분석은 비희소화 count에 pseudocount 0.5를 적용함.
- UNITE 기반 `Kingdom == Fungi` 필터 전후를 모두 기록함.

실제 QIIME 2 provenance를 확인한 결과 ITSxpress는 `region = ITS2`, `taxa = F`(Fungi), `cluster_id = 1`로 실행되었고, 이후 DADA2 single-end는 `max_ee = 2`, `trunc_len = 0`으로 실행되었다. 따라서 아래의 큰 read 감소는 `taxa = All`을 사용해서 생긴 현상이 아니다.

```{r kingdom-table}
kingdom_summary <- function(x, method) {
  otu <- get_otu(x$raw)
  tax <- data.frame(tax_table(x$raw), check.names = FALSE)
  tibble::tibble(
    Method = method,
    Kingdom = dplyr::if_else(is.na(tax$Kingdom) | tax$Kingdom == "", "Unassigned", as.character(tax$Kingdom)),
    ASVs = rowSums(otu > 0),
    Reads = rowSums(otu)
  ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(Method, Kingdom) |>
    dplyr::summarise(ASVs = dplyr::n(), Reads = sum(Reads), .groups = "drop")
}
kingdom_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  kingdom_summary(cutadapt_result, "Cutadapt"),
  kingdom_summary(itsxpress_result, "ITSxpress")
)
readr::write_csv(kingdom_table, file.path(results_dir, "02_kingdom_summary_before_filter.csv"))
datatable_basic(kingdom_table, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound("Reads", 0)
```

# Sample-level read recovery와 alpha summary

```{r sample-qc-data}
sample_qc <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(
    SampleID = sample_names(phy_cutadapt), Method = "Cutadapt",
    Read_Count = as.numeric(sample_sums(phy_cutadapt)),
    Observed_ASV = as.numeric(estimate_richness(phy_cutadapt, measures = "Observed")$Observed),
    Shannon = as.numeric(estimate_richness(phy_cutadapt, measures = "Shannon")$Shannon)
  ),
  tibble::tibble(
    SampleID = sample_names(phy_itsxpress), Method = "ITSxpress",
    Read_Count = as.numeric(sample_sums(phy_itsxpress)),
    Observed_ASV = as.numeric(estimate_richness(phy_itsxpress, measures = "Observed")$Observed),
    Shannon = as.numeric(estimate_richness(phy_itsxpress, measures = "Shannon")$Shannon)
  )
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(q2_metadata, by = "SampleID") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Cutadapt", "ITSxpress")))

sample_wide <- sample_qc |>
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Method, Read_Count, Observed_ASV, Shannon) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = c(Read_Count, Observed_ASV, Shannon)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(q2_metadata, by = "SampleID") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Read_Recovery = Read_Count_ITSxpress / pmax(Read_Count_Cutadapt, 1),
    ASV_Recovery = Observed_ASV_ITSxpress / pmax(Observed_ASV_Cutadapt, 1)
  )

readr::write_csv(sample_wide, file.path(results_dir, "03_sample_level_recovery.csv"))
datatable_basic(sample_wide |>
                  dplyr::select(SampleID, Subject_Display, Site_Display, Sample_Type,

                                Observed_ASV_Cutadapt, Observed_ASV_ITSxpress, ASV_Recovery), 15) |>
```

# Aitchison PCoA 및 paired method effect

```{r pcoa-data}
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(cut_species), colnames(its_species))
all_species <- union(rownames(cut_species), rownames(its_species))
align_matrix <- function(x, taxa, samples) {
  out <- matrix(0, nrow = length(taxa), ncol = length(samples),
                dimnames = list(taxa, samples))
  out[rownames(x), colnames(x)] <- x
  out
}
cut_aligned <- align_matrix(cut_species, all_species, common_samples)
its_aligned <- align_matrix(its_species, all_species, common_samples)
clr_rows <- function(x, pseudocount = 0.5) {
  lx <- log(x + pseudocount)
  lx - rowMeans(lx)
}
cut_clr <- clr_rows(t(cut_aligned))
its_clr <- clr_rows(t(its_aligned))
combined_clr <- rbind(cut_clr, its_clr)
rownames(combined_clr) <- c(paste0("Cutadapt__", common_samples),
                           paste0("ITSxpress__", common_samples))

pcoa <- cmdscale(dist(combined_clr), k = 2, eig = TRUE, add = TRUE)
variance <- round(100 * pcoa$eig[1:2] / sum(pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0]), 1)
pcoa_points <- data.frame(pcoa$points, check.names = FALSE)
colnames(pcoa_points)[1:2] <- c("Axis1", "Axis2")
pcoa_df <- pcoa_points |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("RowID") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Method = ifelse(stringr::str_starts(RowID, "Cutadapt__"), "Cutadapt", "ITSxpress"),
    SampleID = stringr::str_remove(RowID, "^(Cutadapt|ITSxpress)__")
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(q2_metadata, by = "SampleID") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Cutadapt", "ITSxpress")))

set.seed(42)
method_permanova <- vegan::adonis2(
  dist(combined_clr) ~ Method,
  data = pcoa_df,
  permutations = 999,
  strata = pcoa_df$SampleID
)
dispersion <- vegan::betadisper(dist(combined_clr), pcoa_df$Method)
set.seed(42)
dispersion_test <- vegan::permutest(dispersion, permutations = 999)

method_stats <- tibble::tibble(
  Test = c("Paired PERMANOVA", "betadisper permutation test"),
  Statistic = c(method_permanova$F[1], dispersion_test$tab[1, "F"]),
  P_value = c(method_permanova$`Pr(>F)`[1], dispersion_test$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"]),
  R2 = c(method_permanova$R2[1], NA_real_)
)
readr::write_csv(method_stats, file.path(results_dir, "04_aitchison_method_tests.csv"))
datatable_basic(method_stats, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound(c("Statistic", "P_value", "R2"), 4)
```

```{r pcoa-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
p_pcoa <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = SampleID), colour = "grey70", alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Method, shape = Subject_Display), size = 3.1,
             colour = "grey20", stroke = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = subject_shapes, drop = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~Sample_Type, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Complete-forward Cutadapt vs ITSxpress — Aitchison PCoA",
    subtitle = "Line connects the same SampleID; shape distinguishes subject/control",
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", variance[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", variance[2], "%)")
  ) + soyeon_theme + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0))
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "04_aitchison_PCoA.png"), p_pcoa,
       width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
p_pcoa
```

# Species overlap 및 paired abundance difference

```{r species-comparison}
relative_long <- function(x, method) {
  sweep(x, 2, pmax(colSums(x), 1), "/") |>
    data.frame(check.names = FALSE) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Species") |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-Species, names_to = "SampleID", values_to = "Relative_Abundance") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Method = method)
}
species_relative <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  relative_long(cut_aligned, "Cutadapt"),
  relative_long(its_aligned, "ITSxpress")
)
species_means <- species_relative |>
  dplyr::group_by(Species, Method) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Mean = mean(Relative_Abundance), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = Mean, values_fill = 0) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Combined_Mean = (Cutadapt + ITSxpress) / 2)

top_species <- species_means |>
  dplyr::slice_max(Combined_Mean, n = 20, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::pull(Species)

species_tests <- species_relative |>
  dplyr::filter(Species %in% top_species) |>
  dplyr::select(Species, SampleID, Method, Relative_Abundance) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = Relative_Abundance, values_fill = 0) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Species) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean_Cutadapt = mean(Cutadapt), Mean_ITSxpress = mean(ITSxpress),
    Mean_Difference = mean(ITSxpress - Cutadapt),
    P_value = if (all(Cutadapt == ITSxpress)) 1 else
      stats::wilcox.test(ITSxpress, Cutadapt, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(BH_q = p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH")) |>
  dplyr::arrange(BH_q)

overlap_table <- tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c("Cutadapt detected Species", "ITSxpress detected Species", "Shared Species",
             "Cutadapt only", "ITSxpress only"),
  N = c(sum(rowSums(cut_aligned) > 0), sum(rowSums(its_aligned) > 0),
        sum(rowSums(cut_aligned) > 0 & rowSums(its_aligned) > 0),
        sum(rowSums(cut_aligned) > 0 & rowSums(its_aligned) == 0),
        sum(rowSums(cut_aligned) == 0 & rowSums(its_aligned) > 0))
)
readr::write_csv(overlap_table, file.path(results_dir, "05_species_overlap.csv"))
readr::write_csv(species_tests, file.path(results_dir, "05_species_paired_wilcoxon.csv"))
datatable_basic(overlap_table, 10)
datatable_basic(species_tests, 20) |>
  DT::formatPercentage(c("Mean_Cutadapt", "Mean_ITSxpress", "Mean_Difference"), 2) |>
  DT::formatRound(c("P_value", "BH_q"), 4)
```

```{r species-scatter, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
p_species <- ggplot(species_means, aes(x = Cutadapt + 1e-6, y = ITSxpress + 1e-6)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(size = Combined_Mean), colour = "#542788", alpha = 0.7) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = species_means |> dplyr::filter(Species %in% top_species),

  soyeon_theme + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0))
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "05_species_mean_scatter.png"), p_species,
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

# Sample별 Species composition

```{r composition, fig.width=16, fig.height=10}
display_species <- species_means |>
  dplyr::filter(Combined_Mean > 0.01) |>
  dplyr::pull(Species)
composition <- species_relative |>
  dplyr::mutate(Taxon = ifelse(Species %in% display_species, Species, "Other")) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Method, SampleID, Taxon) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Relative_Abundance = sum(Relative_Abundance), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::left_join(q2_metadata, by = "SampleID") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Cutadapt", "ITSxpress")))

pal <- c(
  setNames(colorRampPalette(c(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"), brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"),
                              brewer.pal(8, "Accent")))(length(display_species)), display_species),
  Other = "grey85"
)
p_comp <- ggplot(composition, aes(x = SampleID, y = Relative_Abundance, fill = Taxon)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal, breaks = c(display_species, "Other")) +

  facet_grid(Method + Sample_Type ~ ., scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +

       subtitle = "Legend threshold: combined mean relative abundance >1%",

                       legend.text = element_text(size = 8))
```

# ASV sequence length와 frequency 비교

```{r sequence-data}
read_sequences <- function(method) {
  seqs <- qiime2R::read_qza(file.path(root_dir, "dada2", tolower(method), "single", "repseq.qza"))[["data"]]
  seq_chr <- as.character(seqs)
  ids <- names(seqs)
  if (is.null(ids) || any(ids == "")) ids <- rownames(get_otu(if (method == "Cutadapt") phy_cutadapt else phy_itsxpress))
  counts <- rowSums(get_otu(if (method == "Cutadapt") phy_cutadapt else phy_itsxpress))
  tibble::tibble(
    Method = method, FeatureID = ids, Sequence = seq_chr,
    Length_bp = nchar(seq_chr), Total_Reads = as.numeric(counts[ids])
  )
}
sequence_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(read_sequences("Cutadapt"), read_sequences("ITSxpress"))
readr::write_csv(sequence_table, file.path(results_dir, "07_ASV_sequences_length_frequency.csv"))
```

# Cutadapt–ITSxpress 서열 containment

```{r containment}
cut_seq <- sequence_table |> dplyr::filter(Method == "Cutadapt")
its_seq <- sequence_table |> dplyr::filter(Method == "ITSxpress")

best_match <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(its_seq)), function(i) {
  hit <- which(vapply(cut_seq$Sequence, function(x) grepl(its_seq$Sequence[i], x, fixed = TRUE), logical(1)))
  if (length(hit) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      ITSxpress_FeatureID = its_seq$FeatureID[i], ITSxpress_Length = its_seq$Length_bp[i],
      ITSxpress_Reads = its_seq$Total_Reads[i], Cutadapt_FeatureID = NA_character_,
      Cutadapt_Length = NA_integer_, Cutadapt_Reads = NA_real_, Match = "No exact containment"
    ))
  }
  j <- hit[which.max(cut_seq$Total_Reads[hit])]
  tibble::tibble(
    ITSxpress_FeatureID = its_seq$FeatureID[i], ITSxpress_Length = its_seq$Length_bp[i],
    ITSxpress_Reads = its_seq$Total_Reads[i], Cutadapt_FeatureID = cut_seq$FeatureID[j],
    Cutadapt_Length = cut_seq$Length_bp[j], Cutadapt_Reads = cut_seq$Total_Reads[j],
    Match = ifelse(its_seq$Sequence[i] == cut_seq$Sequence[j], "Exact identical", "ITSxpress within Cutadapt")
  )
})

containment_summary <- best_match |>
  dplyr::count(Match, name = "ITSxpress_ASVs") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Read_Sum = purrr::map_dbl(Match, ~sum(best_match$ITSxpress_Reads[best_match$Match == .x])))
readr::write_csv(best_match, file.path(results_dir, "08_ASV_exact_containment_pairs.csv"))
readr::write_csv(containment_summary, file.path(results_dir, "08_ASV_containment_summary.csv"))
datatable_basic(containment_summary, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound("Read_Sum", 0)
```

# BLAST-confirmed Raphanus ASV의 ITSxpress 잔존 여부

```{r raphanus-check}
raphanus_id <- "5c8f111a2f4a8e9e41a1cb58ebc985f6"
raphanus_row <- cut_seq |> dplyr::filter(FeatureID == raphanus_id)
raphanus_sequence <- raphanus_row$Sequence[1]
raphanus_matches <- its_seq |>
  dplyr::filter(
    Sequence == raphanus_sequence |
      vapply(Sequence, function(x) grepl(x, raphanus_sequence, fixed = TRUE), logical(1))
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Cutadapt_FeatureID = raphanus_id)

raphanus_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  Item = c("Cutadapt ASV total reads", "Cutadapt ASV length", "ITSxpress exact/contained ASVs", "ITSxpress matched reads"),
  Value = c(
    ifelse(nrow(raphanus_row) == 0, 0, raphanus_row$Total_Reads[1]),
    ifelse(nrow(raphanus_row) == 0, NA, raphanus_row$Length_bp[1]),
    nrow(raphanus_matches), sum(raphanus_matches$Total_Reads)
  )
)
readr::write_csv(raphanus_summary, file.path(results_dir, "09_Raphanus_ASV_ITSxpress_check.csv"))
readr::write_csv(raphanus_matches, file.path(results_dir, "09_Raphanus_ASV_ITSxpress_matches.csv"))
datatable_basic(raphanus_summary, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound("Value", 0)
```

이 표는 NCBI nt에서 *Raphanus sativus*와 281/281 bp, 100% identity로 확인된 Cutadapt ASV가 fungal ITS HMM 기반 ITSxpress 결과에 동일 또는 내부 서열 형태로 남았는지를 직접 확인한다. ITSxpress 결과에 없을 경우에는 `--taxa Fungi` 단계가 이 비표적 식물 ITS를 제거한 결과와 일치한다. 단, ITSxpress는 taxonomy classifier 자체가 아니므로 모든 비진균 서열 제거를 보장하지 않는다.

# 요약

```{r dynamic-summary, results='asis'}
cat(paste0(
  "- Cutadapt: **", ntaxa(phy_cutadapt), " fungal ASVs / ",
  scales::comma(sum(sample_sums(phy_cutadapt))), " reads**.\n",
  "- ITSxpress: **", ntaxa(phy_itsxpress), " fungal ASVs / ",
  scales::comma(sum(sample_sums(phy_itsxpress))), " reads**.\n",
  "- 공통 SampleID: **", length(common_samples), "개**.\n",
  "- ITSxpress/Cutadapt sample read recovery median: **",
  scales::percent(median(sample_wide$Read_Recovery, na.rm = TRUE), accuracy = 0.1), "**.\n",
  "- paired Aitchison PERMANOVA: R² = **", round(method_permanova$R2[1], 4),
  "**, p = **", signif(method_permanova$`Pr(>F)`[1], 3), "**.\n",
  "- BLAST-confirmed Raphanus ASV와 exact/containment 관계인 ITSxpress ASV: **",
  nrow(raphanus_matches), "개**.\n"
))
```

본 비교는 library 처리 방법의 기술적 차이를 평가한다. 동일 피부 시료에서 반복 PCR된 library들은 독립적인 생물학적 표본이 아니므로, 여기의 paired method test를 대상자 수준의 생물학적 효과로 해석하지 않는다.

## 보수적 해석

- ITSxpress는 Cutadapt read의 일부를 단순히 정리한 수준이 아니라, 전체 read의 작은 부분만 남긴 강한 선택 단계로 작동했다. sample별 ITSxpress/Cutadapt read recovery 중앙값은 약 6%이다.
- ITSxpress ASV 211개 중 176개는 Cutadapt ASV 내부에 정확히 포함되어, 동일 원서열의 ITS 내부 구간을 추출했다는 점은 확인된다. 그러나 35개는 exact containment로 연결되지 않았다.
- BLAST에서 *Raphanus sativus*로 확인된 281-bp Cutadapt ASV(68,588 reads)는 ITSxpress 결과에 exact/containment 형태로 남지 않았다. fungal HMM이 해당 비표적 식물 ITS를 제거한 결과와 일치한다.
- 동시에 Cutadapt에서 풍부했던 *Malassezia restricta*, *M. globosa*, *Aureobasidium tremulum*은 현재 ITSxpress taxonomy에서 거의 또는 전혀 재현되지 않았다. 그러므로 이번 ITSxpress 결과를 곧바로 “더 정확한 피부 진균 조성”으로 채택하면 안 된다.
- 완전한 forward read가 ITS2와 양쪽 보존 flank를 충분히 포괄하지 못한 taxon에서는 ITSxpress HMM 경계 탐지가 실패할 수 있다. ITSxpress ASV 길이 중앙값도 Cutadapt 281 bp 대비 148 bp로 짧다. 따라서 Malassezia 소실은 생물학적 부재가 아니라 경계 인식 및 길이 선택 편향일 가능성을 우선 점검해야 한다.
- Aitchison PERMANOVA와 betadisper가 모두 유의하므로, PCoA의 method 차이는 centroid 이동만이 아니라 dispersion 차이도 함께 포함한다. 이를 순수한 조성 변화로 단정하지 않는다.
